name: ref-telemetry-silence
displayName: REF - a workstation has stopped reporting
description: Returns a row for each expected workstation that has not sent a heartbeat in fifteen minutes. Silence is treated as an event: an agent killed, a network cut or a machine powered off all produce the same absence of data. Raised after WS02 stopped reporting for over an hour on 26 September 2026 while in active use, unnoticed.

criteria.query: let seen = Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m) | summarize by Computer; datatable(Computer:string)["WS01","WS02"] | where Computer !in (seen) | extend Problem = strcat(Computer, " has sent no telemetry in 15 minutes")
